Electronic Service & Digital Delivery Policy

Last Updated: November 11, 2026

RealSalePro, operated by Synergy Brand Architect, provides cloud-hosted Software as a Service (SaaS) applications for real estate builders, developers, and brokers. Because our software and services are exclusively delivered over the internet, no physical goods or physical parcels are shipped, and zero physical shipping or handling charges apply.

1. Instant Digital Delivery & Workspace Provisioning

  • Immediate Provisioning: Upon completing registration for our Free Forever plan or upon confirmation of payment for a paid subscription, your multi-tenant CRM workspace is automatically provisioned and activated in real time (< 60 seconds).
  • Electronic Confirmation & Credentials: You will immediately receive an automated confirmation email and WhatsApp alert containing your direct workspace login URL (realsalepro.com/login), tenant ID, and initial administrator credentials.
  • Browser & Mobile Access: The platform is fully accessible instantly via any standard modern web browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox) on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices without requiring software downloads or hardware installations.

2. Service Delivery Timeframes

  • Standard SaaS Accounts: Instant digital activation upon successful signup.
  • Meta Lead Ads & Portal Webhooks: Webhook credentials and automated lead routing links are generated in your dashboard immediately upon account creation.
  • Enterprise Self-Hosted Database (BYOD): For enterprise clients opting for a private PostgreSQL or AWS RDS database integration behind their corporate VPC, configuration and custom domain deployment typically complete within 5 to 10 business days in coordination with your IT security team.

3. Shipping Charges & Customs Duties

Since all services are delivered electronically across India and globally, there are zero shipping fees, zero handling charges, and zero customs fees associated with any RealSalePro plan or add-on.

4. Delivery Inquiries & Customer Support
